name: GeoVanguard benchmark
description: Data, results and scripts of the benchmark in the SoftwareX article "GeoVanguard: topology-preserving smoothing of large polygon coverages for QGIS and Python". GeoVanguard 1.0.1 (Gaussian method) is compared with ArcGIS Pro 3.7.1 Smooth Shared Edges and Smooth Polygon, QGIS 4.2.2 Smooth, GRASS GIS 8.5.0 v.generalize (sliding averaging, Chaiken) and Mapshaper 0.7.83 on synthetic and real single-class and multi-class maps. Each tool's parameter was tuned for the highest mIoU against a finer truth map on tuning sets and applied to separate test sets; topology errors (gaps, overlaps, invalid polygons), area change, boundary accuracy and border shape were measured. Run time, peak memory, CPU cores, tile seams and resumption were measured on a forest-type map with up to 385,679 polygons. inputs.zip: source maps, nested forest-type windows and the truth/input sets. results.zip: outputs, metrics and logs. scripts.zip: the scripts with instructions. See README.md.
